newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Hungarian MOL has good oil flow rate in Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian MOL has good oil flow rate in Tunisia.

text.p: MOL Hungarian Oil & Gas has made an encouraging oil discovery in its oil permit of Kebili, in southern Tunisia, its Tunisian partner state-owned oil company ETAP said on Tuesday.
ETAP said that MOL re-entered in June 1996 the West Sabria well discovered in 1981 by Amoco and drilling tested up to 1,700 bpd.

"This encouraging hydrocarbon flow rate incited both MOL and ETAP to run a long-term test in order to observe the behaviour of the Ordovician fractured siliciclatic reservoir, prior to the development of the field," ETAP added.
MOL and ETAP were granted the 5,180 square kilometers onshore Kebili exploration permit in December 1991.

ETAP said that the Ordovician play was still under-exploited and that the Sabria discovery as well as hydrocarbon bearing in several wells in the area provide a "highly potential hydrocarbon play" there.
